import { Progress, Button, Card } from "march/ui" // Progress'in bütün özellikleri bir arada: value + max, tone, color, colors (brand / liste / single) + paint, // label, ariaLabel, showValue (yüzde ya da kendi metnin), valueText, size (ad ya da piksel), variant (bar / line), // orientation, track, inverse, smooth, decorative, fillRef, segments + duration + paused + run + onDone, class const tones = ["primary", "success", "warn", "danger", "info"] as const // bir başlık ve altında içerik const Box = (props: { title: string; children?: unknown }) =>
{props.title} {props.children}
export function ProgressLab() { let $v = 40 let $story = 0 let $paused = false let $done = 0 return
{tones.map((t) => $v} tone={t} label={`Ton ${t}`} showValue size="sm" />)} $v * 4.8} max={480} label="Video" showValue={(p: number, mb: number) => `${Math.round(mb)} / 480 MB (%${p})`} valueText={(v: number, m: number) => `${Math.round(v)} MB / ${m} MB`} class="lab-video" />
$v} decorative class="lab-line" /> $v} size="lg" ariaLabel="Dikey" class="lab-vertical" /> { el.dataset.driven = "yes" }} value={30} ariaLabel="Sürülen dolgu" />
$story} duration={1500} paused={() => $paused} run={() => $story} onDone={() => { $done++; $story = ($story + 1) % 4 }} ariaLabel="Hikâye" valueText={(i: number, m: number) => `${i + 1} / ${m}`} class="lab-story" />
{() => `Biten parça: ${$done}`}
$v} inverse label="Medya üzerinde (inverse)" showValue />
}
